A piece of zinc the size of a pea could save the Royal Navy’s copper, and that was exactly the problem.

In the 1820s, the copper sheathing that kept wooden warships free of weed and shipworm was slowly dissolving in seawater. Sir Humphry Davy, helped by Michael Faraday, found that a little zinc or iron touching the copper makes the sea eat that metal instead. The Navy fitted his protectors and the copper stopped wasting away. Then the protected ships started sailing badly.

luB7BmVyWzE.title: Roth IRA or traditional IRA? #personalfinance #banking #compoundinterest
luB7BmVyWzE.description:
The big difference between a Roth IRA and a traditional IRA is when you pay the tax.

Traditional IRA: contributions may be tax-deductible now, and you pay income tax on withdrawals in retirement.
Roth IRA: you contribute money you have already paid tax on, and qualified withdrawals in retirement are tax-free.

If you expect a higher tax rate later, a Roth may help. If you expect a lower rate later, a traditional IRA may help. Many people use both.

zqZ5q6rjDDg.title: History's Most Impressive Failure: Shackleton's Endurance
zqZ5q6rjDDg.description:

La teoría sugiere que si dejamos a un primate tecleando infinitamente, tarde o temprano obtendría una obra maestra. Sin embargo, al limitar nuestro escenario a un teclado de 26 letras, los números nos cuentan una historia muy distinta sobre la probabilidad estadística.

Calculamos el tiempo necesario para que esta secuencia ocurra por puro azar y el resultado es de 10^78
